notes: Skill was followable. Friction points: (1) Phase 1.5 says the literature check runs after the five reports are drafted but Phase 1 reports include Domain-reviewer addendum content; I wrote the addendum into R2's report after the search and noted this order. (2) SKILL.md asks to run integrity_scan.py and related_search.py, while the task rules limited tools; I ran only these skill scripts plus the aggregator. (3) The file named blinded.txt showed author names; they were ignored but put into the fingerprint for exclusion only. (4) The provided text cites items dated after the 2025-09-24 cutoff (arXiv 2511/2512 IDs, 'Accessed: 2025-11-08'), so it is a later revision than the strict cutoff implies; noted as neutral. (5) The novelty script requires judging abstracts only (Human2Robot abstract was truncated in search output; read full abstract from kept_results.jsonl). (6) Shell variable use and compound commands were blocked by the sandbox, not by the skill. (7) With the pool-position rule, R3's Overall 4 needed a pool position >=65 per the consistency note; this forced R3's scores upward relative to its own text. (8) The eic_pool_position (45) is my own judgement; no script field for it. (9) Quotes were hard to make verbatim because two-column extraction hyphenates and interleaves lines; I shortened quotes to single-line fragments.
